description: Publishes a countersigned receipt (already signed by both seller and buyer) to the public log, as lasting proof of delivery for a deliverable hash. Signing happens on your side with the free library; this server never holds keys. The server re-verifies the receipt and rejects seller-only or invalid ones. Optional seller_link and buyer_link pages are checked for proof that they belong to the signing key (match, mismatch or unreachable). Published receipts are public.

receipt.description: A Wayreceipt delivery receipt (W3C Verifiable Credential 2.0 with eddsa-jcs-2022 proofs).

name: publish_delivery_receipt
title: Publish a countersigned receipt
